# ICMA 9-10-2026

```{r}
ggplot(data=penguins, mapping = aes(x=flipper_length_mm,
                                    y= bill_length_mm)) + 
  geom_point()
```

```{r}
PlantGrowth
ggplot(data=PlantGrowth,
       mapping=aes(y=weight,x=group)) + 
  geom_point(alpha=0.5) +
  stat_summary(geom="pointrange",
               fun.dat="mean_se",
               color="purple")
```
Yes this is tidy data
